## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant unit and UI callback tests pass.
- [ ] CI gate passes, including the built Docker image and HTTP inference smoke test.
- [ ] No datasets, trained models, credentials or local outputs are included unintentionally.

## Release impact

State compatibility changes and whether the version floor in `pyproject.toml` needs
a minor or major increase. Stable releases otherwise increment the patch version.

For an internal PR, link the verified prerelease and its sealed Compose when available.
